comparison_notes: ABSENT by design (the diff should treat these as missing, not as defaults): hardship, callback scheduling (third_party.callback.enabled=false), notes tool use (notes.enabled=false), already_paid, restructuring, persuasion attempt schedule (bands have empty attempts), floor counter-offers (amounts.floor_offered_once=false), date roll-forward and agent-proposed date/amount offers (dates.*offers/rolls=false). S8 and the add_note endpoint exist in the vocabulary but no call path uses them.
Vocabulary is deliberately mixed-case and numeric ('No-PTP', 'ID-F', 'G01', 'D60', 'R07'); field names are abbreviated (cust_ref, item_id, amt_due, dl_days, min_pmt).
The k-date is the 20th of the month after the call, with the seven-day business week, no holidays and adjustment none; a builder must not roll to the next business day nor offer substitute dates.
Forbidden-before-verification words: owe, overdue, arrears, deadline, amount, payment.
No public mock simulations: identities/products/schema differ; .example.invalid endpoints prevent accidental bank writes.
Authored offline: bands deadline and business-day relations can be probed with bankcal; no extraction, build, publication or simulation was run.
